typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	totblcalypsotradeservRedPairCdsIdx_outputfilename as string ()
}

source(output(
		TRADE_ID as decimal(38,0),
		PRODUCT_ID as decimal(38,0),
		INDEX_DEF_ID as decimal(38,0),
		SEC_CODE as string,
		CODE_VALUE as string,
		PRODUCT_FAMILY as string,
		PRODUCT_TYPE as string,
		PRODUCT_SUB_TYPE as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> fromproductseccode
fromproductseccode derive({Copy of CODE_VALUE} = CODE_VALUE,
		{Copy of PRODUCT_TYPE} = PRODUCT_TYPE,
		{Copy of PRODUCT_ID} = toString(PRODUCT_ID),
		{Copy of PRODUCT_SUB_TYPE} = PRODUCT_SUB_TYPE,
		{Copy of INDEX_DEF_ID} = toString(INDEX_DEF_ID),
		{Copy of PRODUCT_FAMILY} = PRODUCT_FAMILY,
		{Copy of SEC_CODE} = SEC_CODE,
		{Copy of TRADE_ID} = toString(TRADE_ID)) ~> DataConversion
DataConversion sink(input(
		Product_Sub_Type as string,
		Product_Id as string,
		Product_Family as string,
		Index_Id as string,
		Trade_Id as string,
		Sec_Code as string,
		Code_Value as string,
		Product_Type as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,errorHandlingOption: 'allErrors',reportSuccessOnError: true,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		Product_Sub_Type = {Copy of PRODUCT_SUB_TYPE},
		Product_Id = {Copy of PRODUCT_ID},
		Product_Family = {Copy of PRODUCT_FAMILY},
		Index_Id = {Copy of INDEX_DEF_ID},
		Trade_Id = {Copy of TRADE_ID},
		Sec_Code = {Copy of SEC_CODE},
		Code_Value = {Copy of CODE_VALUE},
		Product_Type = {Copy of PRODUCT_TYPE}),
	partitionFileNames:[($totblcalypsotradeservRedPairCdsIdx_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> totblcalypsotradeservRedPairCdsIdx
